title: Marlowe Rewards Points Account Windows: Missing Points and Inactivity
content:
These are the time limits on a Marlowe Rewards points account: when a missing-points request can be raised, whose orders can be credited, and how long a points balance can go without earning before it is forfeited.

## Missing-points terms (every tier)

| Term | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Latest a missing-points request is accepted | 90 calendar days after the order's placed date |
| Earliest a missing-points request may be raised | 3 calendar days after the order's dispatch |
| Points can be credited only to the membership of the customer profile that placed the order | Yes |

## Inactivity period by tier

| Tier | Calendar months without an earning posting after which the whole points balance is forfeited |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 12 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 12 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 12 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 18 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 24 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 24 |

## Notes

- The missing-points windows are counted in calendar days. One runs from the date the order was placed and the other from the date it was dispatched.
- The inactivity period is counted in calendar months. Only earning postings count: points earned on an order or credited as a missing-points adjustment.
